name: LINGUA AI Skill Taxonomy
description: Distinct skill hierarchies separating DLD spoken-language domains from Dyslexia written-language domains

DLD_SUPPORT.evidenceBasis: CATALISE Phase 1 & 2 [S1, S2], ASHA Spoken Language Disorders [S3], Winters et al. 2022 [S5], Donolato et al. 2023 [S7]

domains.name: Vocabulary Breadth & Depth
domains.description: Targeted word learning with phonological and semantic cues and retrieval practice

domains.name: Morphosyntax & Grammar
domains.description: Grammatical morphemes, verb tense agreement, and syntactic structures

domains.name: Sentence Formulation & Comprehension
domains.description: Building and understanding complex sentence clauses and connecting ideas

domains.name: Listening Comprehension
domains.description: Following multi-step oral instructions, extracting central themes, and inferencing

domains.name: Structured Expressive Speaking
domains.description: Oral sentence formulation, describing events, and conversational turns

domains.name: Narrative Macrostructure & Retell
domains.description: Story grammar elements: setting, initiating event, internal response, attempt, consequence

domains.name: Social Communication & Pragmatics
domains.description: Contextual communicative intent, conversational repair, and perspective taking

LITERACY_SUPPORT.evidenceBasis: IDA 2025 Definition [S20], Catts et al. 2026 [S21], Hall et al. 40-Year Meta-Analysis [S23], WWC Foundational Reading [S24]

domains.name: Phonological & Phonemic Awareness
domains.description: Sound isolation, blending, segmenting, and phoneme manipulation

domains.name: Systematic Phonics & Grapheme Mapping
domains.description: Explicit sound-symbol correspondence, vowel teams, and syllable types

domains.name: Word Recognition & Decoding
domains.description: Regular decoding, multisyllabic word attack, and high-frequency orthographic recognition

domains.name: Spelling & Orthographic Patterns
domains.description: Encoding phonemes into graphemes, morphological spelling rules, and word families

domains.name: Reading Fluency & Automaticity
domains.description: Accurate, paced reading in connected text with natural phrasing

domains.name: Text Comprehension & Strategy Use
domains.description: Comprehension strategies, summarization, and text structure analysis

domains.name: Written Expression & Sentence Construction
domains.description: Structuring written sentences, paragraphs, and editing with assistive tools

SHARED_ACCOMMODATION_TOOLS.evidenceBasis: Wood et al. 2017 TTS Meta-Analysis [S26], Understood AT [S27, S28], WCAG 2.2 AA

tools.name: Text-to-Speech & Read Aloud
tools.description: Adjustable speed, synchronized word highlighting, and voice selection

tools.name: Speech-to-Text & Dictation
tools.description: Voice typing with user-initiated recording and manual text editing

tools.name: Adaptive Text & Contrast Display
tools.description: Font selection (Atkinson Hyperlegible), line/letter spacing, contrast themes
